definition: Unexpected changes and difficulties occurring throughout someone's life or circumstances.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: In the evening I started, by that conveyance, down the road I had traversed under so many vicissitudes.
example_sentence: The shop survived the vicissitudes of three recessions.
